detail.longDescription: Jeremy Andrews shared a code review pattern we like at Tag1. Instead of letting an AI bot post straight to the pull request, you point it at a review staging layer GitHub and GitLab both have built in. The AI reads every line of the diff and stages its notes; you decide what actually goes out under your name. Full setup for both: https://www. tag1.com/how-to/human-in-the-m iddle/ # DevOps # AI # OpenSource
